description: The endpoints increase strictly with a_n at least n; their consecutive intervals partition the natural numbers, and both the even interval union and its complement are infinite.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.interval_properties (g : ℕ → ℕ) :
  StrictMono (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.intervalEndpoint g) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ), n ≤ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.intervalEndpoint g n) ∧
      ⋃ n,
            Set.Ico (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.intervalEndpoint g n)
              (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.intervalEndpoint g (n + 1)) =
          Set.univ ∧
        (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.alternatingIntervals g).Infinite ∧
          (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.SplittingReaping.alternatingIntervals g)ᶜ.Infinite
